// diagnostic

E0516

A failure can't pass out of a deep check

What

A failure can't pass out of a deep check

Why

A deep check runs only where `--deep-checks` keeps it, so whether the function goes on can't depend on it.

Fix

Handle the failure inside the body, with `??` or `or`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0516: tests/ui/deep_check_try.stderr.

Error [jet.DeepCheckPropagatesFailure]: A failure can't pass out of a deep check
  --> tests/ui/deep_check_try.jet:8:16
    |
  8 |         assert(parse("ab")?("reading the count") == 1, "the count is one")
    |                ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A deep check runs only where `--deep-checks` keeps it, so whether the function goes on can't depend on it.
 Fix: Handle the failure inside the body, with `??` or `or`.
